title: Measured whether a failed-OUT_OF_RANGE ATTACK task is held: it is not what held the sticky task, closed as a non-defect for its own premise
summary: Measured OUT_OF_RANGE verdicts and followed the attacker task on four corpus worlds; the missing OUT_OF_RANGE reset was not the cause of a 851-tick held ATTACK task, which was the action router posture gate returning a silent no-op (fixed under TCK-20261005-SILENT-NO-OP-RETURNS-IN-ACTIONROUTER-HOLD-THE-TASK-AND-ANNOTATE-FALSE-SUCCESS)

title: Action router reports a posture-withheld or unsupported action as a typed failure so its task ends, and the task annotation drops a stale reason
summary: ActionRouter returned bare no-ops from the posture gate and fall-through, so the task was annotated SUCCESS, kept and re-dispatched (one entity held 839 ticks); now ACTION_WITHHELD_BY_POSTURE and UNSUPPORTED_ACTION clear the task via the existing unrecoverable branch; frontier_living_world withheld entity-ticks 844 to 2

title: Tactics and legality predicates agree on corpus content; the friendly-fire verdicts are the opportunity-attack scan's routine filter, closed as a non-defect
summary: Measured both hostility predicates at every legality call over four worlds x two runs: 0 disagreeing entity pairs, has_clean never false, and all 583 FRIENDLY_FIRE_ILLEGAL verdicts come from the movement opportunity-attack scan; latent dead raw-equality fallback filed separately
